The brushless motor climbs through a mechanical whine as the model gathers pace — mid-strip it tracks the centreline with small rudder twitches, gear sinking slightly into the grass, wings rocking fractionally. Speed accumulates in clear stages across the long strip. Only when the wings are genuinely loaded by airspeed does the nose gear lighten; mains leave the turf a natural beat later, the direct result of reaching flying speed. A shallow forward climb-out follows, forward motion dominant over climb rate, a small pitch bobble, one gentle wing rock. A scrap of paper skitters across the turf behind it.
